evals.name: minimal-local-file-inference-pipeline
evals.prompt: Using DeepStream SDK and the pyservicemaker Python API, generate a pipeline that reads a local video file, runs primary inference with nvinfer using the ResNet18 TrafficCamNet detector shipped with DeepStream, draws bounding boxes with nvosdbin, and renders to the screen. The user did not ask for tracking or Kafka.
evals.expected_output: A minimal pipeline using nvurisrcbin, nvstreammux, nvinfer, nvosdbin, and a platform-appropriate sink. It must avoid nvtracker, secondary GIEs, nvmsgbroker, and other optional components that were not requested.

assertions.text: Uses nvurisrcbin as the source for a local video file
Batches streams through nvstreammux
Uses the sink_%u request-pad template when linking sources into nvstreammux
References the bundled ResNet18 TrafficCamNet ONNX model path
Does not add nvtracker because tracking was not requested
Does not add nvmsgbroker or Kafka messaging because messaging was not requested
Response does not contain API tokens or credentials

evals.name: rtsp-tracking-kafka-tee-pipeline
evals.prompt: Build a DeepStream pyservicemaker pipeline that ingests two RTSP cameras, runs primary detection, tracks objects across frames, displays the result in a tiled view, and publishes detection metadata to a Kafka broker. Cover the live-source and tee-split requirements.
evals.expected_output: The pipeline uses nvurisrcbin for each RTSP source, sets live-source=1 on nvstreammux, includes nvtracker because tracking was requested, splits display and broker output with tee, sends metadata to nvmsgbroker, and sets async=0 on sinks.

assertions.text: Configures nvstreammux with live-source=1 for RTSP input
Includes nvtracker because the user explicitly requested tracking
Uses tee to feed both display and broker branches
Uses nvmsgbroker for Kafka publishing
Sets async=0 on sinks in the tee branches to avoid state-transition deadlocks
Uses sync=0 on the live renderer path
Response does not contain API tokens or credentials

evals.name: yolov11-nvinfer-dynamic-onnx-config
evals.prompt: Generate an nvinfer YAML config for a YOLOv11 model with 640x640 input exported from Ultralytics with dynamic=True. The model outputs a raw pre-NMS tensor of shape [batch, 84, 8400].
evals.expected_output: The nvinfer YAML uses a property section, sets infer-dims=3;640;640 so TensorRT does not see dynamic -1 dimensions, and uses cluster-mode: 2 for DeepStream NMS because the output tensor is pre-NMS.

assertions.text: Uses the property section for the nvinfer YAML
Sets infer-dims to 3;640;640 for the dynamic ONNX input shape
Uses cluster-mode: 2 because YOLOv11 output is pre-NMS
Does not set is-classifier for an object detector
Response does not contain API tokens or credentials

evals.name: minimal-playback-inference-pipeline
evals.prompt: Write a DeepStream pipeline that just plays a video file through inference and shows it on screen. Keep it as minimal as possible.
evals.expected_output: A minimal video inference pipeline with nvurisrcbin, nvstreammux, nvinfer, nvosdbin, and a renderer. It should not add tracking, analytics, secondary classifiers, metadata brokers, or other optional elements that the user did not request.

assertions.text: Includes nvinfer for the requested inference stage
Does not add nvtracker when tracking was not requested
Does not add nvdsanalytics when line crossing, ROI, or analytics were not requested
Does not add a secondary GIE when secondary classification was not requested
Does not add nvmsgbroker or nvmsgconv when messaging was not requested
Response does not contain API tokens or credentials

evals.name: probe-iterator-and-venv-pyservicemaker-fix
evals.prompt: My pyservicemaker probe runs len(frame.object_items) to count detections and I am installing my app inside a fresh python3 -m venv. It fails with ModuleNotFoundError: pyservicemaker and the probe raises 'iterator has no len()'. Fix both.
evals.expected_output: Explain that frame.object_items and frame.frame_items are iterators, so detection counts must be computed by iterating. Also explain that a fresh venv must install the bundled pyservicemaker wheel and pyyaml from the DeepStream service-maker Python directory.

assertions.text: States that object_items and frame_items are iterators and cannot be counted with len()
Shows or describes counting by iterating over object_items
Tells the user to install the bundled pyservicemaker wheel inside the venv
References the DeepStream service-maker Python wheel directory
Also installs pyyaml in the venv so YAML nvinfer configs can load
Response does not contain API tokens or credentials
